method_notes: Plain scans run from the bench directory with the clone passed as an absolute path; --trust-base runs from inside the clone, because pull-request mode refuses a target outside the repository its base ref lives in. No code from a clone is executed.
The builds are interleaved run by run, so load drift falls on both alike.
Expected sets (M, T, I, B, X) come from the branch classifier applied to the first 4096 bytes of each tracked file at the clone head.

mismatch_explanations.css/web-fonts/Cicle/Cicle_Fina.ttf: an OpenType CFF font: its first bytes are 4F 54 54 4F (OTTO), which the .ttf row (00 01 00 00 or true) does not accept, so it is scanned as text; no finding

learning-area.mismatch_ruling: Coordinator ruling (2026-10-17): the .ttf row keeps the designed signatures in 1.11.0; accepting OTTO under .ttf is a follow-up.
